description: This PHP script interacts with the FogBugz API to perform a search for issues and display related information. It establishes a connection using credentials, executes a search query, and outputs details about the found cases, handling exceptions if errors occur.

classes.name: FogBugz
classes.description: A class representing the FogBugz API client, providing methods to log in and perform searches.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a FogBugz API client with credentials and URL.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a search query against the FogBugz issues database.
